notes: Univariate EDA from the script: PROC FREQ on MARITAL_STATUS/GENDER/LOAN_APPROVAL_STATUS and PROC MEANS (N NMISS MIN MAX MEAN MEDIAN STD) on LOAN_AMOUNT/CANDIDATE_INCOME. Self-contained: script.sas builds WORK.TRAINING_DS (24 rows, 13 cols) inline via datalines sampled from TRAINING_DS.csv and aliases LIB78400 to WORK, so it also runs standalone on /v1/quick. The upstream library dataset is not shipped in the repo.
